result_provenance.production_behaviour: only policy 'v13' (an asserted byte-identical replica of the production parser)
result_provenance.simulation: every other policy is an OFFLINE research simulation; none is implemented in src/gitscore
result_provenance.development: controls.dev -- the set the policies were designed against
result_provenance.weakly_held_out_synthetic: controls.holdout -- run once after policy_design_freeze.json; same author, could be recalled, NOT independent
result_provenance.previously_inspected_private: private_admission_aggregates.json -- previously inspected postings with pre-existing labels; NOT independent validation
posthoc_adjustments: EMPLOYER_SUBJECT was case-insensitive, so the country abbreviation 'US' matched the pronoun 'us'
a concessive negation ('while not required, ... is a plus') was treated as a general negation
result_provenance.posthoc_consequence: both defects were found on the private label-backed postings, so B1NR/B1R/CR results on those postings are post-hoc, not unseen; known risk for G21
result_provenance.known_holdout_failure: m11g20-h003 ('You must be on call ...') is admitted by every policy

held_out_from_design: private label-backed claim annotations (first run only; post-hoc variants were corrected after that run and are labelled posthoc)
